name: stremio.tvvoo
description: Stremio addon VAVOO only: catalogs by country, resolves clean HLS using viewer's IP (ipLocation) or provide Direct link

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const copy=(s,d)=>{if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}; copy('public/landing.html','dist/landing.html'); copy('src/channels/lista-it.m3u','dist/lista-it.m3u'); copy('public/tvvoo.png','dist/tvvoo.png'); copy('src/channel-cover-maps.generated.json','dist/channel-cover-maps.generated.json'); copy('src/tvvoo-cover-maps.generated.json','dist/tvvoo-cover-maps.generated.json')" && node scripts/build-split-lists.js
